name: createSessionEventChatProvider
description: Connect a backend that emits standard SessionEvent snapshots and documented lifecycle frames through configurable HTTP operations.
notes: Web and self-owned backends use this same public factory; paths, identity headers and JSON envelopes are application configuration.
Requires reset/ready/event/ping/done/error control frames; it does not parse original Bailian deltas.
Defaults: connectTimeoutMs 30000, idleTimeoutMs 45000. An unexpected EOF remains retryable.
Protocol version headers are explicit request configuration. Writes are never automatically retried.

name: SessionEventChatProviderOptions
description: Injected RequestClient, one stream operation, four required mutations/queries, optional thread queries and message conversion.

name: SessionEventStreamOperation
description: Build the subscription path and request from Session identity and an opaque update cursor.

name: BackendOperation
description: Typed backend request construction and response mapping executed once by the shared Request layer.

name: BackendRequestContext
description: Provider-owned cancellation propagated through request construction and response mapping.

name: BackendRequestSpec
description: A backend path and optional RequestInit whose signal is owned by the Provider.

name: createSseStream
description: Decode an existing byte stream into raw SSE frames without network or business conversion.
notes: Use for await; data remains a string and the Provider validates its business meaning.
Defaults: utf8Fatal false; flushOnEnd true; no frame limit unless maxFrameChars is supplied.
Cancellation, early iterator exit, and parse failure release the reader. EOF is not Agent execution completion.

name: SseStreamOptions
description: Cancellation, UTF-8 strictness, frame size, comment notification and tail-frame delivery.

name: SseStreamError
description: Safe decoding or framing failure, distinct from a reader transport failure.
notes: Providers decide whether failures are retryable; malformed framing is not a successful completion.

name: createRequest
description: Create an independent HTTP client that composes SSE reading with createSseStream.
notes: No automatic retries, timeouts, Kit protocol header or Content-Type.
Application identity headers are resolved for each request; per-request headers take precedence.

name: RequestClient
description: Response, JSON, raw SSE and URL methods for an application backend.
notes: response hands body ownership to its consumer; stream releases it when iteration ends.
json parses JSON without validating its business schema; HTTP 204 returns undefined.

name: RequestOptions
description: Explicit base URL, asynchronous HeadersInit, injected fetch and safe HTTP error mapping.
notes: Provider credentials remain on the backend.
mapHttpError returns an Error, not an arbitrary backend body.

name: ChatProvider
description: Frontend adapter with five required Session operations, optional thread queries and message transformation.
notes: This contract connects the existing Bailian upstream; it is not a second provider abstraction.
Session creation/listing and file upload/download are outside this contract.
Each stream invocation manages one connection; the Controller owns retry scheduling.
Chat owns the event ledger and returned messages; an omitted strategy uses transformSessionEvent.

name: ChatProvider.stream
description: Open one abortable persistent subscription delivering SessionEvent snapshots and lifecycle callbacks.
notes: Announce ready only after authoritative history and live updates are reconciled.
Do not reconnect internally or use a business event ID as an update cursor.
Unexpected EOF is a recoverable transport failure, not business completion.

name: ChatProvider.sendMessage
description: Submit the text and client identity once and return the actual acceptance response.
notes: Preserve client_message_id and event_ids for optimistic message reconciliation.

name: ChatProvider.interrupt
description: Request remote interruption; subscription cancellation alone does not interrupt execution.

name: ChatProvider.toolApprovals
description: Retrieve current pending batch/calls and complete frozen tool arguments.
notes: Historical requests alone must not activate a current approval.

name: ChatProvider.submitToolApproval
description: Submit one real allow or deny decision after backend ownership and pending-state validation.
notes: No automatic POST retries; refresh after an uncertain response before renewed user confirmation.

name: ChatProvider.transformMessage
description: Optional synchronous event-to-message strategy invoked by Chat while rebuilding the latest snapshots.
notes: Omission preserves the default transformSessionEvent behavior.
Do not hold cross-Session messages in the Provider or treat cumulative snapshots as new deltas.

name: transformSessionEvent
description: Default pure SessionEvent-to-ChatMessage strategy shared by the Kit and raw Bailian Providers.
notes: Use the supplied identity to preserve stable message and part IDs.
Changes only presentation; Chat retains execution, optimistic reconciliation, approval, and reconnect state.
This function does not parse raw Bailian SSE or load the SDK normalizer.

name: MessageTransformer
description: Synchronous message transformation function, without persistent state or network access.

name: MessageTransformInput
description: Current-thread temporary messages, one latest SessionEvent snapshot, and its stable Chat-assigned identity.
notes: The array belongs to the current reconstruction; do not retain it after the call or mutate the event.

name: MessageTransformResult
description: The updated or replacement message array and optional artifacts, owned by Chat after return.
notes: Preserve message and part IDs and reconciliation fields when adapting the default result.

name: createKitChatProvider
description: Wrap an existing KitClient with the default transformSessionEvent strategy, preserving request paths, cursors, and retry behavior.

name: StreamSessionOptions
description: Abort signal, optional opaque replay cursor, and reset/event/ready/done/ping callbacks.
notes: onEvent receives cumulative SDK snapshots, including updates to existing event IDs.
onReset starts reconstruction and onReady commits its complete authoritative result.
onDone is explicit transport termination; onPing signals transport liveness.

name: createBailianChatProvider
description: Adapt six required and two optional thread operations through RequestClient into ChatProvider.
notes: Requires the SDK session-events public normalizer. Kit Server thread queries additionally require the new SDK thread APIs; the local candidate must be published and pinned before deployment.
Kit owns framing and recovery; SDK owns cumulative event conversion.
Subscription and message submission are separate requests, not one POST returning a single response stream.
Uses transformSessionEvent for presentation; SDK normalization remains a separate step.

name: BailianChatProviderOptions
description: Required RequestClient and six buildRequest/mapResponse operations with bounded recovery settings.
notes: Defaults: connectTimeoutMs 30000; idleTimeoutMs 45000; maxBufferedFrames 1024; maxBufferedBytes 8388608; maxHistoryEvents 10000.
Limits fail explicitly rather than silently truncating history or dropping buffered updates.
Every reconnect rebuilds full history; no Kit after cursor is forwarded to raw Bailian.

name: openStream
description: Describe the raw subscription request and map its untouched Response with a real upstream-ready promise.
notes: Provider injects cancellation throughout request construction, HTTP and response mapping.
mapResponse must not consume the body or await ready; return both so reading begins while ready is pending.
HTTP 200 or the first business event is not an independent readiness guarantee.
The example accepts x-upstream-ready only under its documented backend subscription-before-headers contract.

name: listEvents
description: Describe one ascending history-page request and map complete raw events with an opaque next-page token.
notes: Preserve event identity, timestamps, content, lifecycle information, and main Session status.
History must be complete; same-ID snapshot conflicts need update evidence.
created_at is not a version of a changed snapshot.

name: BailianStreamResponse
description: Raw streaming HTTP response plus a real upstream-readiness promise.

name: BailianEventsPage
description: Complete raw history objects in ascending order with an optional next page token.
notes: End pagination with null or no token; never reuse a business event ID as a per-update cursor.

name: SessionEvent
description: SDK-owned business event contract consumed by Kit's normalized stream and message projection.
notes: Unknown event types and content blocks remain available for safe fallback rendering.
ready, reset, ping, and done are transport controls rather than business events.

name: SendMessageRequest
description: Text submission with optional optimistic identity; mounting files is a Session-creation operation.

name: SendMessageResponse
description: Actual Session ID, acceptance flag, and submitted event IDs returned by a write.

name: ToolApprovalsResponse
description: Current requires_action state, pending batch/calls, and frozen tool requests.

name: ToolApprovalDecision
description: One explicit allow or deny decision identified by the current batch and call.

name: KitError
description: Safe error code and summary with explicit retryability for Controller recovery.
notes: Do not expose backend response bodies, authorization headers, or provider credentials in errors.
Authorization and contract failures stop automatic reconnect; temporary transport failures may retry.

name: BailianOperation
description: Backend request description and response conversion; HTTP execution belongs to the Provider and RequestClient.

name: BailianRequestSpec
description: Application path and RequestInit without signal; cancellation is owned by the Provider.

name: BailianRequestContext
description: Provider cancellation context shared by request construction and response mapping.

name: createBailianThreadOperations
description: Standard Bailian thread-list and thread-event operation configs; customize proxy basePath or mappings.

name: BailianThreadOperations
description: Optional thread query configurations for the raw Bailian Provider.

name: BailianThreadQuery
description: Session identity and opaque pagination options for a thread query.

name: ThreadQueryOptions
description: Optional page size, cursor and AbortSignal for normalized thread queries.

name: ChatProvider.listThreads
description: Optional child Agent history query; keep Session ownership and cancellation intact.

name: ChatProvider.listThreadEvents
description: Optional child Agent history query; keep Session ownership and cancellation intact.

name: ClientOperations
description: Typed optional operations configured with buildRequest and mapResponse.

name: ClientOperation
description: A supported data Client operation name.

name: ExplicitKitClientOptions
description: Inject Request and operations without hidden Kit routes.

name: createMemberSessionStorage
description: Create injected identity storage scoped to the complete backend URL.

name: normalizeMemberApiBaseUrl
description: Validate and normalize an HTTP backend URL without credentials.

name: streamProtocolFrames
description: Consume documented protocol frames through an injected RequestClient, with cancellation and valid-frame idle detection.
notes: The caller owns the path, identity and protocol headers; this helper does not reconnect or maintain Chat state.
done ends one subscription; error and unexpected EOF reject. The default idle timeout is 45000 ms.
Use only for the documented protocol frames, not original Bailian SSE deltas.
